opennyai_summary.facts:
Order 
This is the third application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS, 2023) by applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 142/2024, registered at Police Station Crime Branch, Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 409, 420,
467, 468, 471, 201, 120-B of IPC.
Earlier applications filed by the applicant were dismissed as withdrawn.
Accused Sanjay Saini prepared forged loan account, in which money was transferred and misappropriated.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is submitted that this is not a case where gold has been stolen from the bank.
It is submitted that applicant does not have any role in opening the gold loan accounts or having control over the gold.
It is submitted by them that applicant is Assistant Manager of the bank and no gold loan account can be opened without information to him.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Applicant is in jail since 03.03.2024.
Investigation is completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
In these circumstances,
application be dismissed.
5. Investigation in the case is completed, charge-sheet has been filed.
Nothing remains to be recovered from the applicant as money is said to have been lost in gambling by co-accused person.
Applicant is aged about 25 years and is in jail for some time.
Trial is likely to take a long time for completion.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the Court concerned on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.
8 . The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:1025 3 MCRC-53277-2024 Section 480 (3) of B.N.S.S. as under:-
(a) that such person shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed under this Chapter;
(b) that such person shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which the is accused, or suspected of the commission of which they are suspected and;
(c) that such person shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
